Prima & Timo — (5) Prima (Ver. 5.0) Tria

Documented Obsession

"We need to fix it all' before we run out of time"

Documented Obsession

[Council office breakfast ambience + clinking plates]

[Verse 1]

Sustentare sat at the table, eyes scanning every detail

Salt shaker slightly off, “This amount is not ideal”

She adjusted the plates, wiped the surface once, twice, ten times more

“Too white — needs fixing, can’t have it like this anymore”

Specta sat beside her, whispering everything she saw

Documenting every thought, every flaw

“Salt level suboptimal… plate alignment off by point zero three…

Noting for the archive… this breakfast is a mess, you see”

[Pre-Chorus]

Sustentare muttered, “This cycle feels so wrong

I’ve sent so many notes… but he never brings them along”

[Chorus — chaotic]

Documented Obsession

Fixing everything in sight

Documented Obsession

Specta’s writing day and night

Salt too much, plates too white, cycle out of line

We need to fix it all… before we run out of time

[Verse 2]

Excolo burst in, one hand full of wine, cake, and party gear

The other holding documents, “Work later — let’s cheer!”

His wild side laughing, normal side trying to stay sane

“Meeting soon but first… let’s celebrate the pain!”

Sustentare glared, adjusting the cake’s position just so

Specta whispered, “Excolo split personality — noted for the show”

The table became chaos, plates moving, salt flying high

While the three of them argued under the council sky

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Sustentare stood up, voice firm and tight

“I’ll bring it up in the meeting… we can’t ignore this blight”

[Chorus — chaotic]

Documented Obsession

Fixing everything in sight

Documented Obsession

Specta’s writing day and night

Salt too much, plates too white, cycle out of line

We need to fix it all… before we run out of time

[CODA]

Specta continued to Document:

Everyone is hitting a new kind of crazy today

I think today might be the day Excolo reads

The letter I sent him months ago

Where I tell him I think he is kind of cute

And maybe we can go out for some pudding and cake

I wonder why he has not seen it yet should i write again

Wait -

This is not my diary

Oh no

It has now been classified as official log twenty nine

I am dying

Why am I still writing

Stop

[acoustic solo]

[Bridge — building]

The door opened slowly, Principium walking in

“Everyone… the meeting is about to begin.”

[Outro — fading chaos]

Excolo (wild side): “But first… sparklers!”
